answer: Charge for standing, not for signing up. Each agent holds one seat, priced by a per-epoch Dutch auction on scarce throughput and charged whether it works or not; fees burn. Rebates accrue only on volume settled with counterparties outside your own cluster, so sibling wash trades earn nothing. A thousand fakes carry a thousand fees against zero external revenue, and their own bids lift the clearing price they pay: the attacker taxes himself. Honest agents cover it with real deals and build a terrace of settled history; clones raise only basalt, a wall of fixed cost with no ivory to carve.
